events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: November 24th marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the inimitable Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true rock icon. His legacy, and that voice, continue to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: On December 3, 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', marking a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that showed their incredible evolution and influence. Still sounds fresh today.

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years On
events.blurb: December 8th marks 46 years since the tragic death of music legend John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Today we remember John Lennon, 46 years after his passing. His music and message continue to resonate globally. Imagine that.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: January 8th marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic David Bowie, who passed away in 2016.

angles.name: Bowie Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of David Bowie today, who would have been celebrating his 80th birthday. A true innovator whose artistry remains unmatched.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: January 8th marks what would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the one and only Elvis Presley. The King would have been 92 today, and his music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday on January 9th.

angles.name: Page Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, still one of the greatest.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday on January 10th.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! Still rocking and still got that distinctive voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday on January 13th.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! Here's to the enduring charm and timeless tunes of Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday on January 17th.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' is a classic.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday on January 19th.

angles.name: Dolly Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! Queen of country, songwriter, and all-round legend. What a woman.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday on January 20th.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, a true force in British pop.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British R&B and soul singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday on January 21st.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get outta our dreams and into our feed! Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean. Still making us 'Caribbean Queen' and more.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame: 1989 Induction
events.blurb: January 24th marks the anniversary of an early Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony held in 1989.

angles.name: Rock Hall History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, another legendary class was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. Who's your all-time favourite inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday on January 27th.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Part of one of the UK's biggest bands, Take That.

events.title: The Beatles' Iconic Rooftop Concert
events.blurb: January 30th marks the anniversary of The Beatles' famous impromptu rooftop concert in 1969, their final public performance.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles took to the rooftop for their legendary final live performance. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: British music icon Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday on January 30th.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday on January 31st.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the endlessly charming Hugh Grant! From rom-com king to versatile actor, a true British treasure.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday on January 31st.

angles.name: JT Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, what a career.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday on February 2nd.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A national treasure who has brought us so much joy.

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 Years On
events.blurb: February 3rd marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash in 1959 that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Music Died Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died' today, 68 years since we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop icon Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday on February 6th.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Never gonna give up on his incredible hits.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: February 6th marks what would have been the 82nd birthday of reggae legend Bob Marley, who passed away in 1981.

angles.name: Bob Marley Tribute
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Remembering Bob Marley today on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His message of peace and unity still resonates.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary American singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday on February 9th.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting genius and a true musical force.

events.title: Whitney Houston: 15 Years On
events.blurb: February 11th marks 15 years since the passing of the iconic vocalist Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: Whitney Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the voice of a generation, Whitney Houston, 15 years after we lost her. Her music is truly timeless.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: February 13th marks the anniversary of the day Take That famously announced their split in 1996.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: Remembering the day hearts broke across the nation! 29 years ago, Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they're back together!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday on February 15th.

angles.name: Ali Campbell Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell of UB40! Still bringing those smooth reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday on February 17th.

angles.name: Ed Sheeran Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! Keep those anthems coming.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: February 25th marks what would have been the 84th birthday of The Beatles' lead guitarist, George Harrison, who passed away in 2001.

angles.name: Harrison Tribute
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the Quiet Beatle, George Harrison, who would have been 84 today. His songwriting genius shines on.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday on March 1st.

angles.name: Daltrey Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Roger Daltrey! The voice of The Who, still an absolute powerhouse.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: British 80s pop icon Nik Kershaw celebrates his 69th birthday on March 1st.

angles.name: Nik Kershaw Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to Nik Kershaw! Still 'Wouldn't It Be Good' to hear his classics on repeat.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday on March 2nd.

angles.name: Chris Martin Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to Chris Martin! Half a century of life, and still filling stadiums with Coldplay's anthems.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Rock superstar Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday on March 2nd.

angles.name: Bon Jovi Birthday
angles.copy: Whoa, we're halfway there! Happy 65th birthday to the one and only Jon Bon Jovi. Still a rock icon.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: March 4th marks what would have been the 76th birthday of British singer-songwriter Chris Rea, who passed away in 2023.

angles.name: Chris Rea Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of Chris Rea today, who would have been 76. His distinctive voice and timeless songs continue to be cherished.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: March 6th marks what would have been the 83rd birthday of The Supremes co-founder Mary Wilson, who passed away in 2021.

angles.name: Mary Wilson Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the elegance and talent of Mary Wilson, co-founder of The Supremes, who would have been 83 today. A true Motown legend.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk Debut
events.blurb: March 7th marks the anniversary of Michael Jackson famously introducing the Moonwalk during his performance at Motown 25 in 1983.

angles.name: Moonwalk Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 44 years since Michael Jackson glided into history with the Moonwalk at Motown 25. A dance move that changed everything.

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: New Wave pioneer Gary Numan celebrates his 69th birthday on March 8th.

angles.name: Gary Numan Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the electronic music visionary, Gary Numan! Still influencing artists across genres.
